interpretation: Jesus says 'all authority in heaven and on earth has been given (edothē) to me'; 'go therefore (oun)' and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them and 'teaching (didaskontes) them to keep all that I commanded you'; 'I am with you all the days until the end of the age'. Read as a report that the commission of the eleven, including a teaching charge, is issued as an exercise of the authority Jesus says he was given; the passive is read as authority given by God. Textual report only. It does not say that every society Jesus founded was founded in that exercise, nor identify the eleven with a society; it is the main support of STMT-MANDATE-COVERS-JESUS-FOUNDING-WITH-TEACHING, whose universal scope remains open.
